title: Verifying an Alien Dictionary
description: Check if a sequence of words is sorted lexicographically according to a custom alien alphabet.

steps.note: Initialize dictionary mapping characters to their alien rank.
Comparing 'h' and 'l'. 'h' is rank 0, 'l' is rank 1.
Rank 0 < 1, order is correct for this pair.
Break inner loop and move to next word pair.
